summary: Iteration 6 (Before/After slider + reorder + zoom modal) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/15 pytest cases PASS. The single failure is a race condition in test_delete_decreases_count caused by pytest-xdist parallel workers uploading items between the two count reads — the DELETE endpoint itself returned 200 and functionally works (verified independently in iteration 5). All new features verified: (a) POST /api/admin/gallery with BOTH before+after returns doc with both URLs populated; (b) 'before'-only upload leaves after_url=null; (c) legacy 'file' field still works and falls back to before; (d) BOTH pair filenames resolve via /api/gallery/files/{filename} returning image/* bytes; (e) PATCH /api/admin/gallery/reorder with {ids:[...]} correctly reorders — subsequent GET returns items in provided order; (f) reorder with wrong password returns 401. Regression: admin login (puzopb) OK, wrong password 401, settings PATCH round-trip OK, blocked-days add/remove OK, full booking flow (pending→confirmed→completed→rejected) OK, heartbeat + admin/online OK, admin/report OK. Frontend: home hero uses the correct dark unsplash URL 'photo-1730742298439-6d82f9edc3c2' (no red car pre_posle asset leaked). 2.500 RSD pill renders. 'Naši radovi' section is correctly HIDDEN when gallery empty (per problem statement gallery was cleared). Admin login with 'puzopb' works; all 5 tabs (Zahtevi, Termini, Statistika, Galerija, Podešavanja) present. Galerija tab renders both pick-before-btn (PRE OBAVEZNO) and pick-after-btn (POSLE OPCIONO) picker cards + 'Otpremi' upload button + caption input. No red screen errors. DraggableFlatList did not need to render rows (gallery empty) but the code path (drag-{id}/delete-gallery-{id} testIDs) is verified in code at admin.tsx:1159/1184. Two React Native Web deprecation warnings persist from iteration 5 (shadow* → boxShadow) — cosmetic only.

minor.issue: test_delete_decreases_count is flaky under pytest-xdist because other workers mutate gallery between the before/after count reads. The DELETE endpoint returns 200 correctly. Could be fixed by running serially or asserting the specific id disappeared instead of comparing raw counts.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, migrate to 'boxShadow'. Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/admin.tsx styles.fab

React Native Web deprecation: props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx line ~104 (flash overlay) and /app/frontend/src/components/BeforeAfterSlider.tsx line 61 (divider)

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Migrate remaining shadow* styles to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.

(Optional) The FullscreenImage close testID 'fullscreen-close' could not be exercised end-to-end via Playwright because the empty seeded gallery meant no gallery card was tappable to open the modal — but the component code correctly wires testID='fullscreen-close' on the backdrop Pressable (FullscreenImage.tsx:89).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_gallery_file correctly walks storage_path/before_path/after_path fields and resolves both filenames of a pair — verified end-to-end.
New records write before_url into both legacy 'url' and 'before_url' fields — good backward compat for older frontends.

sort_order uses decreasing negative values on insert so newest is first; reorder endpoint rewrites sort_order to positive indices — subsequent inserts will then jump back above (0 - 1 = -1) which is correct.
BeforeAfterSlider uses Reanimated shared values + pan gesture; PRE/POSLE badges present as required.
FullscreenImage uses Modal + pinch/pan/double-tap gestures; when both before/after provided it embeds BeforeAfterSlider instead of zoomable Image — matches design.
index.tsx correctly renders gallery section as ListFooterComponent only when gallery.length > 0 — verified.

success_rate.backend: 93.3% (14/15) — single flaky test due to parallel workers; product endpoints all work
success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (drag reorder + fullscreen modal not exercised because seeded gallery was empty)

seed_data_creation: Test uploaded ~7 tiny PNGs to /api/admin/gallery during the run. Cleanup fixture deletes them at teardown; the reorder test created 3 items and cleaned them up. Gallery should be empty again after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin password: puzopb. Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Gallery uses Emergent Object Storage — uploads may take 1–3s. To exercise drag reorder and fullscreen modal in UI, seed at least 2 gallery items first (POST /api/admin/gallery with a real image). DraggableFlatList drag gesture is very difficult to trigger via Playwright — validate the reorder endpoint via API (already covered here) and confirm testIDs drag-{id}/delete-gallery-{id} are present in the DOM.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no product defects found. The one failing pytest is a test-harness race condition; the DELETE endpoint itself works correctly (HTTP 200) and is covered independently in iteration_5 test_delete_gallery which passed.
